record.one_liner: Work management platform for tasks, docs, goals and team collaboration, with a public REST API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Personal API token (begins with pk_) sent as the Authorization header; OAuth 2.0 flow for apps used by other people.
record.access_notes: Any ClickUp account (including Free Forever plan) can generate a personal token. critic: confirmed self_serve_free; Free Forever plan has public API rate limit of 100 requests/min per token.
record.api_notes: Public REST API specification is linked from the developer docs landing page; endpoint coverage was not checked page by page.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed. MCP on Free Forever is capped at 100 calls per 24h without the Everything AI add-on, not a blocker for the API.

evidence.quote: For personal use, authenticate with your personal API token.
For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow, allowing users to authorize Workspaces for your app.
Anyone with a ClickUp account can generate a personal token.
Free Forever, Unlimited, and Business Plans: 100 requests per minute, per token.
Our MCP server URL is https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp.
ClickUp's MCP Server is available on all plans.
